title: Price drift from list price
statementMd:
Find order lines where the customer paid a different unit price than the product's current list price. Show order id, product name, list price and unit price.

Expected columns: `order_id`, `name`, `list_price`, `unit_price`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Join items to products and compare.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT oi.order_id, p.name, p.price AS list_price, oi.unit_price FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.unit_price <> p.price;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
